quantities.why: The values printed came from a run that predated the engine fixes. The committed results file records K 68 over 9,752 records at 1.73 records per second, repair 12,282.0 of 12,365.5 seconds, 2 of 340 case-variant pairs in a shared node, 260 with neither key supported, and silver ARI 0.0013.

quantities.what: E28 restart curve: the mean accuracy when k orders are run and the shortest description is kept
quantities.why: The first pass estimated the curve from subsets of only twenty runs, so almost every large subset contained the same shortest-description run, which flattered both the mean and the spread. The committed file uses sixty independent orders and random subsets: 0.8691, 0.9138, 0.9284, 0.9399, 0.9508, 0.9579, 0.9666 for k of 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 40.

quantities.what: E21: the best untuned baseline on the matched representation
quantities.why: The first version of the matched representation gave the baselines a column per (key, value) pair but none per key, withholding the key presence the engine prices through its absence code. With the key columns the untuned baseline reaches 0.9898 on Wikipedia and 1.0 on the eight-group stream.

quantities.what: how E41's three planted seeds should be described
quantities.source: code/experiments/e4_baseline_army.py:planted8 seeds the generator, not a shuffle
